subject.title: feat(ui): gateway browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect in the web Control UI

question: Should the first web browser-panel release include remote interaction, annotation, and DOM inspection together, or ship a narrower staged browser-view slice first?
rationale: This is a broad new operator-admin product surface, and the protected maintainer signal plus linked issue discussion require explicit scope approval beyond fixing implementation defects.

options.title: Ship full scope after repair
options.body: Keep navigation, interaction, annotation, and inspection together, but land only after the findings, conflicts, and exact-head proof are resolved.

options.title: Stage the first release
options.body: Land browser viewing, navigation, and chat handoff first, then review annotation and DOM inspection separately.

recommendation.title: Ship full scope after repair
recommendation.body: Keep navigation, interaction, annotation, and inspection together, but land only after the findings, conflicts, and exact-head proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history makes steipete the strongest available owner for the Control UI and browser product-scope decision.
